# Contract clause search

*Client industry: legal | Completed: 2023-12-11 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p04*

## The problem
The client was a legal team searching PDFs with Ctrl+F.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, an in-process similarity index, answers grounded in retrieved company documents, FastAPI. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project made clause lookup across 9,000 contracts take seconds.
